title: Modern black-and-white marketing website for 'Column and Case' menswear brand

requirements.text: Create a responsive multi-section marketing website for the modern men’s fashion brand named “Column and Case” with a neat, clean, plain black-and-white aesthetic.

quotes: Create a website for modern mens fashion name is column and case, keep it neat colour palette is black and white keep it neat clean and plain

acceptanceCriteria: Site name “Column and Case” is prominently displayed in the header and page title
All pages/sections use a strictly black/white/gray palette (no color accents)
Layout is minimal with ample whitespace and consistent spacing across breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)

requirements.text: Implement a simple navigation and page structure suitable for a small fashion brand site: Home, Collection, About, and Contact (can be separate routes or clearly separated sections).

quotes: Create a website for modern mens fashion name is column and case

acceptanceCriteria: Users can access Home, Collection, About, and Contact from a top navigation (desktop) and a mobile-friendly menu (mobile)
Navigation clearly indicates the current page/section
All navigation items work without console errors

requirements.text: Add a “Collection” area presenting a clean product grid for modern menswear with placeholder items (e.g., outerwear, shirting, trousers, accessories), each showing an image, product name, and price.
acceptanceCriteria: Collection grid renders at least 8 products with consistent card layout
Each product card shows an image, name, and price in English
Grid is responsive (1 column on small screens, increasing on larger screens)

requirements.text: Add an “About” section describing the brand in a minimal editorial style using English copy (short and restrained).
acceptanceCriteria: About content is in English and references “Column and Case”
Typography is readable and consistent with the minimalist theme
Section is accessible via navigation

requirements.text: Add a “Contact” section with a simple contact form UI (name, email, message) and a clean footer with basic brand links.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact form includes fields for name, email, and message and a submit button
Submitting the form shows a clear on-screen confirmation (no external email integration required)
Footer includes brand name and at least 2 links (e.g., Collection, About)

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme across the site that stays strictly black-and-white and feels modern, neat, clean, and plain (typography, spacing scale, button style, borders, and hover states).

quotes: keep it neat colour palette is black and white keep it neat clean and plain

acceptanceCriteria: Buttons/links/inputs share a consistent style system (e.g., thin borders, subtle hover inversion)
No bright colors are introduced; only black/white/grays are used
Overall styling looks intentionally minimalist (not default browser styling)

requirements.text: Add and render generated static brand images from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not fetch images from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the React UI
At least a logo/wordmark and a hero image are visibly used on the site
No backend endpoints are used for serving these images

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text
Do not add third-party authentication or external database dependencies
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or the immutable hook files listed by the platform
nonGoals: Implementing checkout, payments, or shopping cart functionality
Integrating email delivery services for the contact form
